% Pattern: number/appendix. The \appendix of the class sets the format of the
% lemmas to A\arabic{lemma} and their counter to 0, so the lemma of the appendix
% is A1 and not 3. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 2
% want lemma-3 statement/lemma A1
\documentclass{appjour}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{Lemma} Every compact space is fine. \end{Lemma}
\begin{Lemma} Every fine space is compact. \end{Lemma}
\appendix
\section{Proofs}
\begin{Lemma} Every closed space is fine. \end{Lemma}
\end{document}
